name: piui
description: Pi coding agent client — OCUI visual shell + Pi-native runtime

scripts.build: npm run build -w @piui/protocol && npm run build -w @piui/pi-worker && npm run build -w @piui/server && npm run build -w @piui/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @piui/protocol && npm run build -w @piui/pi-worker && npm run typecheck -w @piui/server && npm run typecheck -w @piui/app
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
